create_metric_logger: create a MetricLogger to track training metrics like loss and accuracy with smoothed values
init_distributed_mode: initialize distributed training mode using environment variables for multi-GPU or SLURM setups
save_and_load_model: save a model checkpoint with optimizer state or resume training from the last checkpoint

inflate_2d_to_3d: inflate a 2D model state dict to 3D by expanding patch embedding and positional encoding weights
